payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP table d[i][j] = finish time of picture i on painter j, using recurrence d[i][j] = max(d[i-1][j], d[i][j-1]) + t[i][j].
payload.rationale: Solution explicitly uses a 2D array and DP recurrence over picture and painter indices, which is textbook 2D dynamic programming for flow shop completion times.
